name: 85745 · Tucson, AZ
findings: ZIP 85745 (Tucson) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85745 (Tucson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85745 (Tucson) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
